summary: Cango Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting that it regained compliance with the NYSE minimum share price requirement (Section 802.01C). The NYSE had notified the company on March 10, 2026 that its average closing price fell below US$1.00 over 30 consecutive trading days. In response, Cango effected a 10-for-1 reverse share split (consolidation) of its Class A and Class B ordinary shares, effective July 20, 2026. After this action, the NYSE determined that the average share price for the 30 trading days ended August 31, 2026 exceeded the US$1.00 minimum, closing the matter. No board action, advisors, or special-situation transaction terms are disclosed. This is a routine listing-compliance notification following a share consolidation, not an extraordinary corporate event beyond typical delisting remediation. What to watch: ongoing maintenance of the share price above US$1.00.
